verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships an official CLI (rdme) that programmatically drives project configuration (OpenAPI upload, versions, docs sync) and this was confirmed live via probe (npx rdme --version succeeded), plus a working MCP JSON-RPC endpoint was confirmed with a full handshake — both are agent/CI-drivable surfaces. However, the evidence pack never cites ReadMe's own REST API reference/docs for platform management (the API reference evidence given, e.g. readme-docs-1, is about customers' hosted API docs, not ReadMe's own control-plane API), so the 'documented public API' claim is only indirectly evidenced through the CLI wrapper. Missing for 10: a direct citation of ReadMe's own API reference documentation for platform operations, and independent confirmation beyond the CLI/MCP probes.
